tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground under the gradient glow. Midnight is the default; Day is a soft lavender paper for settings and billing.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Frosted cards, the player bar and sheets floating over the gradient. Always paired with line.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: Solid cards where blur is unavailable; inputs; the empty track of progress rings.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on glass cards and dividers. Never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text. 9.4:1 on midnight, 7:1 over the violet glow, 6.2:1 on Day.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Gradient stop 1 (start). Deep Focus, primary actions. White text on it passes 5:1.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Gradient stop 2 (middle). The brand's signature hue; the check-in and AI moments.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Gradient stop 3 (warm undertone). Timer ring, progress, streaks and the sunrise glow. A graphic colour, not body text.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Calm Mind and Wind Down accents; selected chips on Day.

tokens.name: violet-glow
tokens.usage: The large blurred violet orb behind every screen.

tokens.name: orange-glow
tokens.usage: The warm orb in the lower corner; stronger during breaks and finishes.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the blue-to-violet button gradient.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Errors, report and block. Not used on the support screen.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline on every interactive element.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; gaps between list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins; card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Space between page sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Breathing room around the timer and hero areas.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and artwork thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass cards, sheets and the player bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, toggles, round controls.
